claim: The completed native Astra and Claude architecture reviews are visible in the existing local observation pipeline, with provider usage categories reconciled to native results and bounded logs/metrics.
scope: Read-only correlation of the exact two existing architecture-review runs. No inference rerun, readiness probe, service change or general conversation/archive read.

provisional_event.accounting: Intermediate snapshot, not added to the final event.

astra.correlation: Unique local SDK observation matched on bounded native-result time, model, status, duration and complete usage; exact observation ID joins its Loki receipt. Unique native metrics process matches native model/time/all categories and joins its log instance. The retained result does not expose a native conversation ID for a direct result-to-conversation join.

claude.correlation: The instance recorded by the native launch receipt exactly matches both Prometheus instance and Loki service_instance_id. Native stdout, receipt, metric categories and the single API event agree. Native session IDs are not retained in the redacted Loki records.
claude.accounting: Cache creation and cache reads are separate input categories. Thinking is included in output. Per-model, iteration and cache-duration views repeat the same usage and are not added again.

prometheus_targets.meaning: Current scrape health snapshot only, not continuous availability or recovery acceptance.

query_bounds.prometheus_evaluation_time: End of the bounded query window

native_commands.purpose: Match the exact SDK observation receipt
native_commands.result: 1 matching redacted record; receipt_id and observation_id both match the unique local observation.

native_commands.purpose: Read bounded native Astra usage categories
native_commands.result: 6 categories, 1 process instance; all values match native usage.
18 redacted codex-app-server records; final native SSE usage agrees.

native_commands.purpose: Read exact native Claude process usage categories
native_commands.result: 4 categories; exact instance from the native launch receipt.

native_commands.purpose: Correlate exact native Claude process logs
native_commands.result: 51 redacted records; one API event matches all four native categories.
7 active targets, 7 up, 0 down, 0 scrape errors.

limitations: Two reviews of one bounded architecture packet demonstrate execution and observation, not the correctness of every model suggestion or a production architecture.
These are model usage totals, not net token savings, subscription billing or an equivalent-task efficiency comparison. Provider tokenizers can differ.
Cached input and thinking subsets are never added twice; provisional and cumulative usage views are not separate requests.

Hook registration, MCP connection events and native lifecycle rows are different measurements. Zero exposed tools means this review does not prove tool execution, every installed MCP, PreToolUse/PostToolUse or PreCompact.
Logs retain structured telemetry and redact bodies. Exact private IDs and machine paths are intentionally omitted from this public-safe receipt.
Seven healthy scrape targets do not establish host reboot recovery, unattended operation, off-host recovery, remote paging or broker execution acceptance.
